SELECT d.id, d.device_code, d.device_name, d.ip_address, d.device_type_id, d.monitor_port, d.location, d.core_flag, d.status, d.last_check_time, d.last_online_time, d.offline_count, d.image_url, d.remark, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_time, t.type_name AS typeName, t.type_code AS typeCode, t.icon AS typeIcon, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM alarm_record a WHERE a.device_id = d.id AND a.alarm_type = 'OFFLINE') AS alarmCount FROM device d LEFT JOIN device_type t ON d.device_type_id = t.id
AND (d.device_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR d.device_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR d.ip_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND d.device_type_id = #{q.typeId}
AND d.status = #{q.status}
AND d.core_flag = #{q.coreFlag}
ORDER BY d.offline_count
ASC DESC
ORDER BY d.last_check_time
ASC DESC
ORDER BY d.device_name
DESC ASC
ORDER BY d.core_flag DESC, d.status DESC, d.id ASC
SELECT IFNULL(t.type_name, '未分类') AS name, COUNT(d.id) AS value FROM device d LEFT JOIN device_type t ON d.device_type_id = t.id GROUP BY t.type_name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM device GROUP BY status
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM device WHERE device_type_id = #{typeId}
